extracted.intended_audience: short-story writers, students of literature, editors and literary critics
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for selecting and judging short stories (here: American magazine fiction of 1917) based on how successfully each piece achieves its aims; emphasizes craft elements like characterization, atmosphere, unity, economy, and authenticity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measure success at author's aim
rubrics_metrics.description: In selecting them, I have sought to accept the author's point of view and manner of treatment, and to measure simply the degree of success he had in doing what he set out to achieve.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judge a story by how well it accomplishes the intention and manner the author chose rather than by a single external standard; personal admiration may influence final winnowing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Faithful and imaginative rendering of folk-life
rubrics_metrics.description: faithful and imaginative rendering of American folk-life
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Depict regional or folk life with both accuracy and creative insight; make local color serve larger artistic ends rather than mere local interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subtle characterization
rubrics_metrics.description: subtle characterization
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Character depth achieved without heavy exposition; can be done through brief, telling phrases or restrained detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy of means
rubrics_metrics.description: the successful manner in which it reveals ... with the utmost economy of means
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Convey character, scene and effect using the fewest and strongest elements; avoid unnecessary verbosity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Characterization through dialogue
rubrics_metrics.description: The characterization is achieved almost entirely through dialogue
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use dialogue to reveal character quickly and memorably; a single phrase can sketch a vivid portrait.

rubrics_metrics.name: Artistic inevitability / convincing resolution
rubrics_metrics.description: its conclusion and the resolution of character that it involves is not more artistically convincing than the end ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The ending should feel earned by the story's development; conclusions that resolve character arcs convincingly are prized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Memorability as a mark of achievement
rubrics_metrics.description: it is certainly a memorable first story by a new writer
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A story's lasting impression or memorability contributes to its judgment as a successful piece of short fiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stark faithfulness of depiction
rubrics_metrics.description: a certain stark faithfulness which makes of somewhat obvious material an extremely vivid and freshly felt rendering of life
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even familiar subject-matter can be invigorated by honest, unflinching depiction and strong observation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality of observation
rubrics_metrics.description: there is a certain quality of observation in the story
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acute perceptiveness about behavior, detail, or environment that gives a story credibility and freshness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appropriate restraint and suggestion
rubrics_metrics.description: greater restraint and less cautious use of suggestion would have better answered his purpose
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Know when to suggest rather than state; too much caution can blunt effect, but over-explicitness can spoil subtlety.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compression and dramatic katharsis
rubrics_metrics.description: It compresses the emotion of a Greek drama into a space of perhaps four thousand words ... the katharsis is timeless in its final solution
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A short story can achieve the concentrated emotional sweep of drama; effective compression and a well-executed catharsis are virtues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Atmosphere over speech
rubrics_metrics.description: Its secret is the secret of atmosphere rather than speech, but atmosphere here becomes human in its reality
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create a pervasive mood or atmosphere that feels lived-in and human; atmosphere can be the primary vehicle of effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imaginative reworking of legend/myth in modern setting
rubrics_metrics.description: Accepting the old legend ... has imagined it reembodied in a modern setting, and out of the ironies of this situation a most dramatic story results
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transposing mythic material into contemporary contexts can yield powerful irony and relevance when done imaginatively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technique vs over-sophistication
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Burt's technique is still a trifle over-sophisticated, but I suppose this is a fault on virtue's side
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical polish is good, but excessive refinement can feel mannered; balance craft with directness of effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imaginative realism
rubrics_metrics.description: His imaginative realism weaves poignant beauty out of the simplest and most dusty elements in life
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use imaginative insight to elevate ordinary material into poignant art without losing realism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Controlled, contrasting narration
rubrics_metrics.description: It makes an art out of coldness in narration which serves to emphasize and bring out by contrast the human warmth of the story's substance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Narrative tone can be deliberately cool or detached to make emotional elements stand out by contrast.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ruthless portrayal of subject (war) regardless of ending
rubrics_metrics.description: a story equally memorable as a ruthless portrayal of the effects of war. Whether one approves or disapproves in general of the ending is irrelevant
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Powerful depiction of harsh realities can justify inclusion even if the moral or resolution is controversial.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mastery and persuasive handling of material
rubrics_metrics.description: he may now fairly claim to have mastered his material, and to have found the most effective human persuasiveness in its presentation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The writer's command of subject and ability to persuade the reader emotionally and intellectually is central.

rubrics_metrics.name: Symbolism rendered human (not mere allegory)
rubrics_metrics.description: symbols and makes of them something more human than a mere allegory
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Symbols should deepen human meaning rather than stand as obvious moral abstractions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustained artistic vigor to the end
rubrics_metrics.description: It shows that Norman Duncan kept his artistic vigor to the last
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain quality and energy across a writer's output; individual stories should show sustained craft.

rubrics_metrics.name: Atmosphere as motive power for characters
rubrics_metrics.description: atmosphere is realized completely for its own sake, and as a motive power urging the lives of his characters to their inevitable end
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Let setting and mood actively shape characters' arcs and choices; atmosphere can drive plot and fate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choose the form appropriate to the theme
rubrics_metrics.description: It is my belief that Edna Ferber is a novelist first and a short story writer afterwards, but in 'The Gay Old Dog' she has accepted a theme which can best be handled in the short story form
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Match subject and scale to form; some themes demand the short form while others belong to the novel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid sentimentalizing the subject
rubrics_metrics.description: Miss Ferber has not sentimentalized her substance as she does most often, but has let it remain at its true valuation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resist sentimental glaze; preserve truthful valuation of subject for stronger artistic effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fit material to form (novelist's material may be ill-fitting)
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Frank ... has not failed to make his two characters real for us, and the poignancy of their final revelation is certainly genuine. Mr. Frank, however, should save such material as this for longer fiction, as his method is essentially that of a novelist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be mindful when a writer's methods (novelist's expansiveness) clash with the short story form; choose or adapt material accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quiet, reticent art and cultural identification
rubrics_metrics.description: With a quiet and somewhat reticent art, the author ... has succeeded in deftly conveying ... a delicate pastoral scene of innocence ... Miss Geer's method is the result of identification with, rather than condescension toward, her subject.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Handle depictions of other cultures with identification and sympathy rather than condescension; a reticent tone can strengthen subtle effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subtle rendering of abnormal psychology
rubrics_metrics.description: Preoccupied as she is with the subtle rendering of abnormal psychological situations ... these stories have the fascination of strange spiritual adventure
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Portray complex psychological states with nuance and craft so that the narrative remains persuasive and fascinating.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of spiritual incident and brooding atmosphere
rubrics_metrics.description: It certainly has the unity of a well-defined spiritual incident ... The brooding atmosphere of a house mindful of its past and reacting upon successive inmates morally ... has seldom been more faithfully rendered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure narrative unity around a central incident or spiritual idea; atmosphere should reinforce thematic unity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural dramatic story sense and reticence
rubrics_metrics.description: Few American writers have such a natural dramatic story sense, and to this Susan Glaspell has added an increasing reticence in the portrayal of her characters. In these two stories you will not find the slightest sentimentalization of her subject matter
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine an instinct for drama with restraint in depiction to avoid melodrama and sentimentality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emotional fidelity and evocative memory
rubrics_metrics.description: This story has all the infectious emotional feeling of memory recalling glorious things, and I can only compare it for its spiritual fidelity toward a cause
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use evocative memory and emotional sincerity to provide spiritual or patriotic resonance where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authenticity from direct apprehension and experience
rubrics_metrics.description: they are based upon a more direct apprehension and experience of life
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories rooted in lived experience or authentic observation often achieve greater conviction than those that are merely imagined.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pictorial perception and evocative language
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Hallet casts glamour over his creations, partly through his detached and pictorial perception of life, and partly through the magic of his words
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use vivid, pictorial language to create a sense of glamour or romance; wordcraft contributes materially to mood.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reserve and seamless merging of character with atmosphere
rubrics_metrics.description: handled it with reserve and power. It is pitched in a quieter key than is usual ... character merges with atmosphere almost imperceptibly
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply reserve to avoid overstatement; aim for subtle interplay where character and atmosphere blend naturally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Artistic weaving of psychological effects (war psychology)
rubrics_metrics.description: artistically woven study in war psychology
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interlace psychological insight into narrative structure so that theme and feeling cohere artistically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emotional validity and handling of situation
rubrics_metrics.description: the emotional validity of her substance is absolutely unimpeachable and her handling of the situation it presents is adequate and fine
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A story's emotional truth must feel undeniable; execution should suit the material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustained convincing creation of setting/genre mastery
rubrics_metrics.description: he has written a memorable sea story that is certainly equal at least to the better stories in Mr. Kipling's latest volume
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mastery of a genre (e.g., sea story) is demonstrated by creating convincing setting, diction and tone appropriate to that mode.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subtle irony and quiet art in portraying effects of war
rubrics_metrics.description: vividly rendered picture of war's effects portrayed with subtle irony and quiet art
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use irony sparingly and a quiet aesthetic to render the human costs of large events effectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment affecting imaginative mind
rubrics_metrics.description: study of the spiritual reactions of a starved environment upon an imaginative mind
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explore how place and conditions shape psychology and creativity; environment can be a central character.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legendary / folk quality grounded in local substance
rubrics_metrics.description: presented a folk story with a significant legendary quality ... the substance with which Mr. Kline deals is the substance of his own people
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Folk or legendary tales should feel rooted in authentic local materials rather than borrowed exotica.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentic voice rather than mere imitation
rubrics_metrics.description: This is the only story I have read in three years in which it seemed to me that I found the authentic voice of 'O. Henry' speaking ... Mr. Lewis is not an imitator
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid slavish imitation of predecessors; capture an authentic voice even when echoing admired writers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excellence in verse storytelling
rubrics_metrics.description: This is the best short story in verse that the year has produced
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate verse narratives on their ability to realize story elements (character, plot, mood) within poetic form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ironic character study with incisive kindness
rubrics_metrics.description: an ironic character study developed with much finesse ... rendered with incisive kindliness
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Irony and kindness can combine to produce a rounded portrait; beware conventional atmospheres that force artificial reader attitudes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fresh treatment of old themes and contrasting character-values
rubrics_metrics.description: has treated an old theme freshly and discovered in it new values of contrasting character
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Find new angles on familiar subjects by focusing on contrasts and fresh characterization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stark, simple construction without affectation
rubrics_metrics.description: With something of Hardy's stark rendering of atmosphere ... woven out of the simplest elements, and with an entire lack of literary sophistication, his story is fairly comparable
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simplicity and starkness can be powerful; affectation or unnecessary ornament can weaken impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Faithful subtleness in suggesting spiritual longing
rubrics_metrics.description: has sought to suggest the spiritual effect of the war upon a certain type of mind ... rendered with faithful subtleness
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subtle suggestion of inner spiritual shifts can be more persuasive than explicit moralizing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creating real spiritual illusion and selection skill
rubrics_metrics.description: she shares ... that gift for making spiritual illusion real ... What is specially distinctive is her gift of selection, by which she brings out the most illusive psychological contrasts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select incidents and details that crystallize elusive psychological or spiritual dimensions; make the intangible feel real.
